finding_key: packages/cli/src/commands/login.ts::the cli half of the nonce feature — sending `clistate` in the oauth url — has no test at all
evidence: login.ts:60-77 builds the OAuth URL with `&cliState=` inside the commander action, but login-callback.test.ts imports only startCallbackServer/stateMatches/UNBOUND_CALLBACK_MESSAGE and mints its own nonce — nothing runs registerLoginCommand's action or asserts the URL contains the nonce. Backend specs inject the nonce directly, so dropping the `&cliState=` term (or desyncing it from the listener's expected state) would pass every test in the diff while breaking every real login. This is a genuine test-adequacy gap in the wiring of the new security feature, though it is a missing test rather than a code defect, hence minor.
